verdict.rationale: ClickUp's MCP docs say a connected AI assistant can "create release notes" from tasks and docs, and the GitHub integration syncs commits and PRs into ClickUp. However, this needs an external AI agent driven by prompts, and nothing shows a changelog generated automatically for each release. Missing for 10: a native automatic per-release changelog trigger, documentation tying Automations or Sprints to changelog output, hands-on or independent corroboration of release-note quality.
